name: I Hate 1111
statement: You are given an integer x. Can you make x by summing up some number of 11,111,1111,11111,..?(You can use any number among them any number of times)
inputFormat:
The first line contains an integer T, number of test cases.
The next t lines contain an integer a.
outputFormat: For each test case print "YES" or "NO".
